Hi Priya —

Got everything, thanks. A couple quick clarifications from finance before we finalize: 
1) For ACH credit we require the full account number in the onboarding portal (we redact it from notifications). Are you comfortable entering the full account number into the secure payops portal?
2) For wire payments we sometimes need an intermediary bank field when the beneficiary bank is mid-tier — do you know if First Meridian requires a correspondent?
3) Can you confirm the PO remapping rule you expect for "EMR_INV_REF" (is it invoice number only or invoice+PO)?

Jordan (cc) will create the PO routing mapping on our side once we have the exact remitter token format. Marissa will pickup verification for micro-deposit or test wire once portal entry is complete.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call Monday to enter details together in the portal.

Thanks,
David
Finance Operations 
Redwood Inference

David —

Answers below: 
1) Yes, we will upload the full account number into the portal. We prefer using the secure upload tool; please send the one-time link.
2) First Meridian does not use an intermediary bank for USD wires with domestic counterparties — you should be able to route directly. If you need SWIFT fields for non-USD, we'll provide separately.
3) EMR_INV_REF should be invoice number only (no PO). Our AP reconciler matches invoice id -> payment line. If Redwood needs invoice+PO please let us know; we can produce a second column.

Happy to do a quick screen-share tomorrow at 10am PT to enter the data.

Best,
Priya

Priya / Team —

Thanks for the clarifications. I'll set up the PO remap so that when payments come in with EMR_INV_REF we match to invoice. Two operational notes: 
- Our portal has a "Remitter Token" field limited to 24 chars. Please confirm whether EMR_INV_REF values will fit (invoice numbers usually 8-12 chars; fine on our side).
- For verification we prefer a small ACH micro-deposit test (two deposits under $1). If you can receive a $0.23 and $0.67 test and confirm the exact amounts we will mark the account verified. For a faster route we can also schedule a $5 test wire and ask you to confirm the trace/ref number.

2) David to approve PO mapping and set remitter token to EMR_INV_REF (invoice only).
3) Marissa to initiate micro-deposit or test wire and confirm.
4) We aim to have the profile live by 5/18 to make the 5/20 payout run.

I'll generate the secure portal link and share in a separate email.

Cheers,
